comments.body:
I consistently get the following error when trying to build this update from an empty ~/.m2/repository/org/fcrepo
https://gist.github.com/awoods/1b055fcea7c012519494ac7a287207e8
Yes, I do too. There's actually no way around it – the OSGi provisioning pulls the artifacts from the maven repo. You have to first do a mvn clean install -DskipTests=true and then a mvn clean verify

It would be worthwhile to load the fcrepo-* modules as described in this ticket:

https://ops4j1.jira.com/browse/PAXEXAM-241

It looks like the supported solution is from the related ticket:
https://ops4j1.jira.com/browse/PAXEXAM-255

What are your thoughts on either:

  • pushing your current PR through... recognizing that Jenkins will never build unless we SSH in and run "mvn clean install -DskipTests", or
  • investigating/incorporating the supported paxexam solution first?
Pax exam now loads the fcrepo-camel bundle from the target directory (and not from the maven repo)
